description: Profit on a buy, fix and sell: the net sale after selling costs, less price, purchase costs, repairs, holding costs and points, with the cash needed, the return on that cash and, with min_profit_pct, the most to pay and still keep that profit. Holding costs are what most flip estimates miss: interest on an interest-only loan plus tax, insurance and utilities for every month held, with months rounded up. Send price, arv, repairs, months and selling_costs_pct; optionally purchase_costs, holding_costs_monthly, loan_pct_of_price, loan_pct_of_repairs, rate_pct, points_pct and min_profit_pct. Omitted loan inputs mean an all-cash flip.

holding_costs_monthly.description: Tax, insurance and utilities per month while held, e.g. 400

loan_pct_of_price.description: Share of the price the lender funds, in percent, e.g. 85

loan_pct_of_repairs.description: Share of repairs the lender funds, in percent, e.g. 100

min_profit_pct.description: Minimum profit as a percent of ARV, e.g. 12, for the most to pay

months.description: Months to finish and sell, e.g. 5 (rounded up, at least 1)

points_pct.description: Points as a percent of the loan, e.g. 2

purchase_costs.description: Closing and other purchase costs, e.g. 3500

repairs.description: All repairs plus resale prep, e.g. 45000

selling_costs_pct.description: Selling costs as a percent of the sale price, e.g. 7

name: compute_flip_profit
title: Flip profit
